Heeey, what's up? ...Yea, it was terrible.\nI encountered the dragon on my way to the town.\nThought I was going to die there.
When the dragon went somewhere, I headed for\nSofya City to see my wife. And I met a few\ntravelers who didn't know the town was destroyed.
They had trouble finding a shop, so I sold\nthe items I had. And yea! I made good\nmoney in a month!
Then, I delivered the household goods to my wife\nand laid in a stock of goods in the city to open\nmy store again like this.
My wife? I can't see her often but she looks\nhappy because I finally got to earn good money.
Welcome! Thanks for coming all the way.\nYou'll find various items, not special though.\nEnjoy your shopping!
Have a nice day!\nOh, please let Straye people know my store\non your way! Thanks!
Hm? ...Oh, I'm sorry.\nI didn't expect you to be here...\nYou came to visit the town here?
...Yes, that's right.\nThe dragon appeared from the forest and...\nYou can see how it ended.
But fortunately, Captain Tenert quickly guided\npeople to a safe place, so there were no \nvictims.
...Huh? Ah, yes. I know I have to take the\nleadership as the mayor of the town but...\nI think I need some time for that...

Hmmm... Hm? Oh! Welcome!\nI'm so sorry, I didn't notice you were here.\nYes? ...Um, right. I was lost in thought.
We buried three boxes, which contain a holy relic,\nin the town to ward off monsters when we created\nthe town.
I just didn't understand why the dragon was\nable to attack the town... So, I dug the places\nwhere the boxes were buried but...
They were gone. All of them! That must have been\nwhy the town was attacked by the dragon...\nIt's really frustrating...
Even if we reconstructed the town, it would be\nattacked again without the holy relics.
I know you have a lot of things to do but...\nCould you find the three boxes?

I appreciate your help. ...Huh?\nI'm afraid we have no clue.\nThey're around here I guess but...
I'm so sorry.\nIt may take time to find all of them.\nPlease be careful on your way.
Oh, you're back!! How did it...\nYou found them all!!\nYou found them in such places? That's surprising.
No wonder the barrier wasn't activated when\nthe dragon attacked the town...\nWe should have checked them often...
I can't thank you enough...\nOh, I almost forgot. I have something for you.
Here you are.\n...You've been a great help to us.\nPlease accept this as a token of our gratitude.
Oh, welcome...\nHm? Ah, yes. We're clearing the rubble away.
People sometimes come here and help me clear away\nthe rubble. But it's still far from\nreconstruction.
Well, we don't have enough materials to rebuild\nthe buildings. You know, we are short-handed...
So, if you have time, could you collect the\nmaterials needed for reconstruction?\nI'll prepare something in return.
I apologize for the short notice...\nI would appreciate if you could help us out when\nyou have time.

Here you are.\n...You've been a great help to us.\nPlease accept this as a token of our gratitude.
Hmmm... Hm? Oh! Welcome!\nI'm so sorry, I didn't notice you were here.\nYes? ...Um, right. I have a little trouble.
People who took refuge in Sofya City often\ncame back to help me restore the buildings, but...\nThey stopped coming these days...
It's because... the monsters are attacking people\nat Suedor Cliff. Actually, some people got hurt.
Oh, yes.\nUm, I hate to ask this of you but...\nCould you get rid of the monsters at the cliff?
We are in a tough situation as you can see but\nI'll do my best to find something for you.
Oh, thank you so much!\nI'm counting on you. One moment, please.
...Here you are. I've written down the names and\nthe number of monsters you need to defeat.\nPlease take it.

Thanks in advance.\nYou'll need to deal with many dangerous monsters.\nPlease be careful.
Oh, welcome back!! How did it...\nGreat! You've defeated all the monsters I asked!\nThe cliff should be much safer now.
I appreciate your help.\nOh, I almost forgot...
Here you are.\n...You've been a great help to us.\nPlease accept this as a token of our gratitude.
Oh, welcome to our town...
... Huh?\n...Ah, yes. Things turned bad to worse...
Actually, goblins are gathering in Rinom Plains\none after another and making loud noises...
I've seen goblins gathering in one place several\ntimes but... This is the first time that they make\nnoises...
We're very anxious that they might be creating\nhorrible weapons or building a fortress...\nI'm ashamed to say but I'm too scared to check it.
So, I'd like to ask you for help.\nPlease investigate Rinom Plains. If you find\nsomething dangerous wipe it out immediately.
I know I'm asking too much but we need your help\nto reconstruct the town smoothly...
I got it
I'm afraid I can't…
I see...it can't be help as it's a big favor so...\nPlease prioritize your business..
I'll ask you for help again when you have time.\nI hope you can accept it then...\nThank you.
I appreciate your help!\nThen, please investigate and remove the cause\nof the noises.
I know you're a very skilled adventurer but\nthere are a lot of goblins in the plains now.\nYou'll have to watch your back...
Welcome back...\nSo, what was the cause of the noises?
...So it was Goblins after all? I knew it!!
What were they... Oh, I see...\nThey didn't open their mouth...
Moralo wouldn't want to know that the horrible\nnoises were a concert...
I don't know what they were up to but...\nThanks to your help, it'll get quiet around here.
Thanks for helping us.\nPlease give us a hand if there's something wrong\naround here again.
